# React Hooks Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > React

## Overview

Creates and optimizes custom React hooks for state management, side effects, and shared logic extraction across components

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [react-hooks-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
react-hooks-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@react-hooks-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build custom hooks with proper dependency management
- Implement useReducer for complex state logic
- Create hooks with cleanup functions for subscriptions
- Design composable hook APIs with proper typing

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Rules of Hooks**: Official hook rules and ESLint enforcement
- **Custom Hooks**: Patterns for building reusable custom hooks
- **Hook Testing**: Testing hooks with @testing-library/react-hooks
